title: Columbia professor on whether Nvidia earnings call helped ease investors' concerns
description:
Did Colette Kress, Nvidia's interim CEO, reassure shareholders in Tuesday's earning call? NPR's Leila Fadel asks Shiva Rajgopal of Columbia Business School.
